item.description: The test_runner_annotated_parameter_inputs tests are failing due to missing or incorrect return values in annotated parameter handling. Specifically, the annotated_object and annotated_object_v1 functions are not properly handling Pydantic models with annotated parameters, causing assertion failures in runner tests.
item.contract: Fix the annotated_object and annotated_object_v1 functions to properly handle Pydantic model parameters with annotated names. The functions should accept annotated Pydantic model parameters and return properly formatted outputs that match expected test assertions.

item.description: Tests in test_script_annotations_outputs are failing due to type mismatch errors where output types don't match annotated types. Specifically, return_list_str returns a list but expects typing.List[str] and return_dict returns a dict but expects typing.Dict[str, str].
item.contract: Modify the return_list_str and return_dict functions to ensure the return types exactly match their annotated types. The functions should return the exact type specified in their annotations to prevent ValueError exceptions.

item.description: Tests are failing with TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for /: 'PosixPath' and 'NoneType' in artifact path resolution. This occurs when trying to join paths where one operand is None, particularly in the file_loader_default_path function.
item.contract: Fix artifact path resolution in artifact_loaders.py to properly handle cases where path components might be None. Ensure that path joining operations don't fail when encountering None values in path construction.
item.acceptance: test_script_annotations_artifacts_no_name_or_path[tests.script_runner.artifact_loaders:file_loader_default_path-an_artifact-Hello there!-Hello there!], test_runner_pydantic_input_artifacts[pydantic io artifact input variations-1], test_runner_pydantic_input_artifacts[pydantic io artifact input variations-2]

item.description: Pydantic validation errors in pydantic_io_v1.py are occurring due to missing arguments and type mismatches in parameter handling. Tests are failing with validation errors related to missing required arguments and incorrect type annotations.
item.contract: Fix Pydantic validation issues in pydantic_io_v1.py by ensuring all required arguments are properly passed and type annotations match the expected input/output types for pydantic input/output parameters.
item.acceptance: test_runner_pydantic_input_artifacts[pydantic io artifact input variations-1], test_runner_pydantic_input_artifacts[pydantic io artifact input variations-2], test_runner_pydantic_output_params[pydantic output parameter variations-1], test_runner_pydantic_output_params[pydantic output parameter variations-2]

item.description: Similar Pydantic validation errors in pydantic_io_v2.py as in v1, involving missing arguments and type mismatches in parameter handling. The test_runner_pydantic_output_params tests are failing with path resolution errors when trying to construct artifact paths.
item.contract: Fix Pydantic validation issues in pydantic_io_v2.py by ensuring all required arguments are properly passed and type annotations match the expected input/output types, while also resolving path resolution issues with artifact paths.
